repos.description: Seth Hobson's large multi-harness plugin marketplace spanning nearly every software domain — languages and frameworks, backend/frontend/mobile, infrastructure and DevOps, security, data and ML, testing, documentation, SEO and business operations. Each plugin bundles focused agents, skills, and commands, with workflow-orchestrator plugins coordinating multi-agent processes. A single Markdown source generates harness-native artifacts for Claude Code and other agent CLIs, agents use a tiered model strategy, and a plugin-eval framework measures plugin and skill quality.

Official Anthropic-curated directory of Claude Code plugins. Internal plugins cover feature development, code review and simplification, frontend design, plugin/skill/MCP/Agent SDK development, CLAUDE.md and setup management, git and commit workflows, hooks, security guidance, output styles, and language-server integrations for many languages, plus a reference example plugin. A separate external-plugins directory holds third-party integrations (code hosts, project trackers, messaging, documentation lookup, browser automation, infrastructure tooling).

Anthropic's open-source role-based plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork (also compatible with Claude Code). One plugin per business function — productivity, sales, customer support, product management, marketing, legal, finance, data, enterprise search, bio-research, design, engineering, HR, operations, and more — plus a plugin for building custom plugins and a partner-built directory. Each bundles skills, commands, sub-agents, and MCP connectors for its function.

Every Inc's Compound Engineering plugin — a methodology structured around a brainstorm → plan → build → review → capture-learnings loop, so knowledge from each change is written down for the next. `ce-`-prefixed skills cover strategy, ideation, planning, execution, debugging, code review, PR workflows, testing, and knowledge capture; review and research subagents ship as references inside their skills. Runs on many agent hosts beyond Claude Code.

Ghost Security's Claude Code plugin marketplace. The AppSec plugin (`ghost`) covers repository context mapping, SAST, SCA exploitability analysis, secrets triage, DAST validation against a live app via an HTTP proxy, and combined reporting. The `exo` plugin builds, improves, and debugs Ghost Security exo workflows.

Jesse Vincent's agentic skills framework and software development methodology. Composable skills enforce a brainstorming → design → planning → subagent-driven development loop with TDD, systematic debugging, git worktree isolation, code review, and verification before completion, bootstrapped by a session-start hook. Installable on Claude Code and many other agent harnesses.

Trail of Bits' Claude Code plugin marketplace for security research, auditing, and engineering. Covers smart contract security, code auditing (language-specific review, differential review, variant analysis, Semgrep rule authoring, static analysis, supply-chain risk), vulnerability triage and patching, verification (constant-time analysis, mutation and property-based testing, spec compliance, formal proofs), reverse engineering, malware signatures, mobile scanning, and developer tooling (modern language practices, GitHub/git workflows, devcontainers, second opinions).

Curated, community-vetted Claude Code plugin marketplace maintained by Trail of Bits. Aggregates and code-reviews third-party skills across development, security (fuzzing, Ghidra, vulnerability scanning), research, writing, and auto-converted OpenAI Codex skills (deploys, GitHub helpers, documents, browser automation, security reviews). Lists other approved marketplaces; every addition is code-reviewed before inclusion.

Corey Haines' marketing skills for AI coding agents, covering CRO, copywriting and editing, SEO, analytics and attribution, A/B testing, paid ads and creative, app store optimization, email and SMS, content and social, launches, pricing and paywalls, onboarding and signup, referrals, competitor research, sales enablement, PR, and marketing planning. Works across multiple agent harnesses.

OpenAI's curated collection of Codex plugins, the successor to the deprecated openai/skills catalog. Each plugin bundles skills and optionally MCP servers, app connectors, agents, commands, and hooks. Covers SaaS and productivity integrations (design tools, project trackers, Google Workspace, cloud and observability services), app-building workflows (iOS and macOS apps, web apps, Expo/React Native, data visualization, games, video), data analytics, life-science research, and a plugin-creator skill. Skills follow the shared SKILL.md format; manifests are Codex-specific.

Matt Pocock's small, composable agent skills for real engineering, addressing common failure modes in AI-assisted development (misalignment, verbosity, broken code, architectural decay). Organized into engineering (TDD, debugging, domain modeling, codebase architecture, specs and tickets, code review, triage, prototyping), productivity (grilling/interviewing, handoffs, teaching, writing for agents), misc tooling setup, and an in-progress bucket. Installable as a plugin or via the skills.sh installer across multiple harnesses.

Addy Osmani's production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, drawing on Google engineering culture (Hyrum's Law, Beyonce Rule, Chesterton's Fence). Lifecycle skills with anti-rationalization tables and verification gates span define (specs, constraints, idea refinement), plan (task breakdown), build (incremental and test-driven implementation, context engineering, frontend and API design), verify (browser testing, debugging), review (quality, simplification, security, performance), and ship (git workflow, CI/CD, migrations, docs and ADRs, observability, launch). Ships lifecycle commands, reviewer/auditor agents, and a meta-skill for routing.

pstack — Lauren Tan's (poteto) rigorous engineering-workflow skills, the standalone mirror of Cursor's pstack plugin, usable from Claude Code and other agent CLIs. Led by poteto-mode (the main entry point with workflow playbooks), plus review and investigation skills (how, why, interrogate, architect, arena, swarm), a set of engineering principle skills, and supporting subagents.
